name: Button
intent: Trigger an action; with asChild, render any element (e.g. a router Link) as a styled button.

chooseOver.because: Wrap a Link with Button asChild for navigation — never navigate via onClick
ToggleGroup selects a value/state; Button performs a discrete action

commonMistakes.symptom: A link that doesn't navigate accessibly / breaks router behavior
commonMistakes.fix: Render the real element with asChild + a Link
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: variant=link for real navigation — use asChild + a Link

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Hover/focus hint. Icon-only buttons should always set this — the icon alone is not a label.

props.name: tooltipSide
props.description: Which side the tooltip opens on. Defaults to "top".

usage: Use Button when you need to provide clear, actionable controls for users. This component signals interactive elements and helps users understand available actions.

Button should be used for primary actions, secondary actions, or any clickable elements that trigger functionality. Ensure adequate spacing between action elements and use appropriate visual hierarchy to indicate action importance.

anatomy.description: Button is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use clear action labels
bestPractices.description: Write button text that clearly describes the action, like 'Save changes' or 'Delete item'.

bestPractices.title: Avoid vague labels
bestPractices.description: Don't use generic text like 'Click here' or 'Submit' without context.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate variants
bestPractices.description: Choose button variants that match the action importance - primary for main actions, secondary for alternatives.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse primary buttons
bestPractices.description: Avoid having multiple primary buttons in the same view, which creates visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Handle loading states
bestPractices.description: Show loading indicators when actions take time to complete.

bestPractices.title: Don't block without feedback
bestPractices.description: Never disable a button during processing without showing a loading state.
